We send the refund after the item passes inspection. Inspection happens within
2 days of pickup.

results.title: Refunds by payment method › Business days
results.text:
Business days are Monday to Friday. A refund sent on a Friday is counted from
the following Monday.

results.title: Returning an item › Inspection
results.text:
We inspect the item within 2 days of pickup. If it passes, we send your refund
(see "Refund timing").

results.title: Refund timing › How long until the refund reaches you
results.text:
After we send the refund, it reaches you in:
- UPI: 1–3 business days
- Wallet: 1–3 business days
- Card: 5–7 business days
- Cash on delivery: 5–7 business days by bank transfer, counted from the day
  you add your bank details

Business days are Monday to Friday.
